text:
Keeping Up With Star Rail — Robin • Summeretto: Happy Birds | Honkai: Star Rail
"Brother, you're here too? Have you heard my new song?"
"Of course, it sounds wonderful. You must be pretty busy lately. What have you been up to?"
"Lately, I've been working on an IP spin-off game called Happy Birds. Basically, it's about launching Origami Birds to knock down the Antimatter Legion. Topping up can also level up the birds. Mid-tier has different colored Owlberts, high-tier has Origami Robin, and whaling on top-ups unlocks... Giant Flying Dove Sunday! Sounds fun, right?"
"...That... sounds... pretty... innovative?"
"Hahaha, just kidding!"
"Hah, I almost thought I'd really turn into a 'Giant Flying Dove.'"
"There you go, that's the expression. Smile a little more! Don't keep a straight face all day, brother."
※ The stats displayed in the combat demo is for reference only. Please regard the launch version as final.
